test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Eshwar Chandra Vidyasagar fought hard against ___________ practices which affected Indian society of his time.
solution:
The correct answer is "**many evil**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The use of "many" is appropriate here because it indicates a large number or variety of evil practices that Vidyasagar fought against.**
 
• Using "all" or "most" would not be accurate as it suggests that Vidyasagar fought against every single evil practice, which is unlikely.
 
• "More" implies a comparison, but there is no context provided for what Vidyasagar was comparing the evil practices to.
 
• The correct form of the sentence would be:
 
 
• "Eshwar Chandra Vidyasagar fought hard against many evil practices __that affected Indian society of his time."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 Option 2: "all evil" suggests that Vidyasagar fought against every single evil practice, which is unlikely.

 Option 3: "most evil" implies that Vidyasagar fought against the majority of evil practices, but it is unclear if this is accurate.

 Option 4: "more evil" implies a comparison, but there is no context provided for what Vidyasagar was comparing the evil practices to.

 Option 5: There is no option 5 provided in the question.
